WITH scored AS (

        h.housenum,

)
SELECT 
    regioncode as location_tag,
    ROUND(AVG(water_score + road_score + parking_score)::numeric, 2) as output_value
FROM scored
GROUP BY regioncode
ORDER BY output_value DESC;

SELECT 
    l.regioncode as location_tag,
    AVG(
        CASE WHEN TRIM(LOWER(i.wateraccess)) LIKE 'yes%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END +
        CASE WHEN TRIM(LOWER(i.roadsurface)) IN ('asphalt', 'concrete') OR TRIM(LOWER(i.roadsurface)) LIKE '%asphalt%' OR TRIM(LOWER(i.roadsurface)) LIKE '%concrete%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END +
        CASE WHEN TRIM(LOWER(i.parkavail)) = 'available' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END
    ) as output_value
FROM households h
JOIN properties p ON h.housenum = p.houselink
JOIN infrastructure i ON p.infralink = i.infraref
JOIN locations l ON h.locregion = l.regioncode AND h.loczone = l.zonenum
GROUP BY l.regioncode
ORDER BY output_value DESC;

WITH scored AS (
    SELECT 
        LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(l.regioncode, '[\s\t]+', ' ', 'g'))) as regioncode,
        CASE WHEN TRIM(LOWER(i.wateraccess)) LIKE 'yes%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END +
        CASE WHEN TRIM(LOWER(i.roadsurface)) IN ('asphalt', 'concrete') OR TRIM(LOWER(i.roadsurface)) LIKE '%asphalt%' OR TRIM(LOWER(i.roadsurface)) LIKE '%concrete%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END +
        CASE WHEN TRIM(LOWER(i.parkavail)) = 'available' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END as facility_score
    FROM households h
    JOIN properties p ON h.housenum = p.houselink
    JOIN infrastructure i ON p.infralink = i.infraref
    JOIN locations l ON h.locregion = l.regioncode AND h.loczone = l.zonenum
)
SELECT regioncode as location_tag, ROUND(AVG(facility_score)::numeric, 2) as output_value
FROM scored
GROUP BY regioncode
ORDER BY output_value DESC;
